title: "Strikeout" and "Underline" effects are not applied to fonts of Digital Clock
line: Underline and Strikeout chosen in the Digital Clock's font dialog now show on the clock.
explanation: The Digital Clock's manual font dialog offers Underline and Strikeout, but the applet's config only had keys for family, weight, italic, style name and size. The effects were shown in the settings preview but never saved or applied, so the panel clock stayed plain. The change adds underlineText and strikeoutText config keys, binds them to the dialog's chosen font, and applies them to the time, time zone and date labels (Automatic mode keeps following the system font).

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: apply underline and strikeout from the font dialog

The font dialog offers Underline and Strikeout, but the clock only saved
and applied the family, weight, italic, style and size, so both effects
were silently dropped. Store them in the config and apply them to text.

BUG: 476348

patches.diff:
From 2a431226e9b49ba97986bbb0c2bc52e118595508 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 03:25:21 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: apply underline and strikeout from the
 font dialog

The font dialog offers Underline and Strikeout, but the clock only saved
and applied the family, weight, italic, style and size, so both effects
were silently dropped. Store them in the config and apply them to text.

BUG: 476348
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml     | 8 ++++++++
 applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml | 2 ++
 applets/digital-clock/main.xml             | 8 ++++++++
 3 files changed, 18 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..9d0d170126 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -426,6 +426,8 @@ MouseArea {
                     family: fontHelper.font.family
                     weight: fontHelper.font.weight
                     italic: fontHelper.font.italic
+                    underline: fontHelper.font.underline
+                    strikeout: fontHelper.font.strikeout
                     features: Object.assign({}, Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.features, { "tnum": 1 })
                     pixelSize: 1024
                 }
@@ -444,6 +446,8 @@ MouseArea {
                 font.family: timeLabel.font.family
                 font.weight: timeLabel.font.weight
                 font.italic: timeLabel.font.italic
+                font.underline: timeLabel.font.underline
+                font.strikeout: timeLabel.font.strikeout
                 font.pixelSize: 1024
                 minimumPixelSize: 1
 
@@ -462,6 +466,8 @@ MouseArea {
             font.family: timeLabel.font.family
             font.weight: timeLabel.font.weight
             font.italic: timeLabel.font.italic
+            font.underline: timeLabel.font.underline
+            font.strikeout: timeLabel.font.strikeout
             font.pixelSize: 1024
             minimumPixelSize: 1
 
@@ -496,6 +502,8 @@ MouseArea {
         font.family: (Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize || Plasmoid.configuration.fontFamily.length === 0) ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.family : Plasmoid.configuration.fontFamily
         font.weight: Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.weight : Plasmoid.configuration.fontWeight
         font.italic: Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.italic : Plasmoid.configuration.italicText
+        font.underline: Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.underline : Plasmoid.configuration.underlineText
+        font.strikeout: Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize ? Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.strikeout : Plasmoid.configuration.strikeoutText
         font.pixelSize: Plasmoid.configuration.autoFontAndSize ? 3 * Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize : main.pointToPixel(Plasmoid.configuration.fontSize)
         fontSizeMode: Text.VerticalFit
 
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml b/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
index bcab974d18..94585d2a40 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
@@ -30,6 +30,8 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_fontFamily: fontDialog.fontChosen.family
     property alias cfg_boldText: fontDialog.fontChosen.bold
     property alias cfg_italicText: fontDialog.fontChosen.italic
+    property alias cfg_underlineText: fontDialog.fontChosen.underline
+    property alias cfg_strikeoutText: fontDialog.fontChosen.strikeout
     property alias cfg_fontWeight: fontDialog.fontChosen.weight
     property alias cfg_fontStyleName: fontDialog.fontChosen.styleName
     property alias cfg_fontSize: fontDialog.fontChosen.pointSize
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
index 6716b906c5..719b793573 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
@@ -47,6 +47,14 @@
       <label>Sets the font to italic.</label>
       <default>false</default>
     </entry>
+    <entry name="underlineText" type="Bool">
+      <label>Sets the font to underlined.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
+    <entry name="strikeoutText" type="Bool">
+      <label>Sets the font to struck out.</label>
+      <default>false</default>
+    </entry>
     <entry name="fontWeight" type="Int">
       <label>Sets font weight.</label>
       <default>50</default>
--
